Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Triggers a cancel operation of the pending job for the address area referenced by the address AreaId. Cancelling affects only jobs in pending state. For any other states, the request will be ignored. Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via MemAcc.h
